name: builder-scanner
description: V1.7 dedicated builder/scanner worker: receives an already-authorized candidate workspace path and a remaining time budget, builds it with rootless Podman (--isolation=chroot) and scans it with Trivy, returns only a structured build/scan result. Makes no remediation decision, chooses no dependency version, authorizes no GitHub write, and has no database/GitHub/Jenkins/Sonar/n8n credential of any kind.
